lines.text: David wrote this song when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, and the king drove him away.
The LORD delivered David from all his fears, and those who look to Him are radiant with sorrow.
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, while young lions go lacking and hungry.
David teaches kings to keep their tongues from evil, turn from evil, do good, and seek peace.
The LORD delivers the righteous from all afflictions, protects all their bones, and redeems His servants.
